metadata.methods_description: Baseline resting EEG was recorded for 5 minutes approximately 2 weeks before the first hypnotherapy session. EEG and ECG data were collected during in-lab hypnotherapy sessions (sessions 1, 4, and 8), while remaining sessions were conducted virtually without physiological recording. Each hypnotherapy session followed a standardized protocol including guided relaxation/induction, visualization of a safe place, guided descent (10 steps), visualization and interaction with imagined objects (chair, crown), identification of light/color, and guided return to wakefulness. Event markers document hypnotherapist phase transitions throughout variable-length recordings.
